releaseNotes: Mobile Storage & Inventory UI Optimization: Fully redesigned medicine storage cards for crystal-clear visibility on mobile phone screens
Medicine Card Structure Fix: High-visibility bold medicine names, clear packaging codes, and pricing badges (PTS, PTR, MRP) without text squishing or layout distortion
Compact Cross-HQ Badges: Replaced vertical column stretch with neat 1-line auto-wrapping depot stock chips
Unified HQ & Depot Switcher: Sleek top-panel filter to easily inspect stock across Kotma, Shahdol, Ambikapur, and Bilaspur depots
Seamless In-Place Update: Release signing ensures smooth APK update without uninstalling or losing device credentials
